votes.motion: Approve the Lunenburg Agricultural Commission 2025 goals
votes.quote: jackie makes a motion to approve the lunenburg agricultural commission 2025 goals as follows: 1. hold 10 meetings of the agricultural commission during the 2025 calendar year 2. review and approve all meeting minutes by the end of the following meeting 3. support community members pursuit of agriculture 4. mediate, advocate, educate, and/or negotiate farming issues 5. explore ideas to managing diseases and ensure animal care 6. community garden a. collect interest about community garden from community b. create a high level outline for community garden 7. farmers' market a. hold a farmers' market b. encourage small local producers to participate c. create a "backyard farmers" area ryan seconded. commission unanimously approve
